summary: The exact HEEW paper was not present in the local related_work directory. The available papers nevertheless support three methodological expectations relevant to this task: benchmark energy datasets should be reproducible, hierarchy-aware analyses should preserve aggregation structure, and dataset publications should include explicit validation checks.

relevant_points: Energy dataset papers should document coverage and validation consistency checks.
Public datasets are more useful when internal validation accompanies release.
Benchmark datasets benefit from reproducible code and baseline-ready packaging.
Public release structure matters for downstream machine-learning use.
Hierarchical or grouped time-series analyses should preserve cross-series heterogeneity.
Hierarchy-aware validation is important when selecting or aggregating power-system entities.
